rules: Do not advance a stage as punishment for a failed roll. Advance it when the player reaches for the Affliction’s power because it was the best option available — that is the moment the bargain tightens. A player who never uses what the Affliction gives them should be able to hold at their current stage indefinitely.

Afflictions and Corruption are separate tracks and do not interact, with one exception: feeding, shifting, or otherwise indulging an Affliction in a way that harms an innocent is exactly the kind of overreach a GM may call for a Corruption check.

afflictions.name: Lycanthropy
afflictions.contracted_by: A wound from an infected creature that crosses 3 or more Stamina boxes in a single hit.
afflictions.incubation: Three nights. A Toughness check vs DC 15 on the third night resists it entirely — success means no Affliction and immunity to that strain.
afflictions.cure: Wolfsbane distillation prepared by someone with Survive 4+, taken during a full moon, followed by a Willpower check vs DC 14 + current stage. Success removes one stage. Stage 5 cannot be cured.

stages.name: Bitten
stages.gives: Your sense of smell sharpens — +1 to Observe rolls that depend on scent.
stages.takes: Restless sleep in the three nights around a full moon. No mechanical penalty yet.

stages.name: Stirring
stages.gives: +1 Toughness. You heal naturally at twice the normal rate.
stages.takes: −1 Serenity. Silver weapons deal +2 damage to you and their wounds do not close.

stages.name: Marked
stages.gives: Regenerate 1 Stamina box per round while out of combat.
stages.takes: On the night of a full moon you shift involuntarily. The GM plays one scene as the beast; you learn afterward what happened.

stages.name: Half-Blood
stages.gives: Once per scene, shift deliberately: +2 Strength, natural weapons that ignore DR 2, and Fast Movement.
stages.takes: −2 to all social rolls with anyone who knows. Under significant stress, Serenity check vs DC 13 or shift involuntarily.

stages.name: Beast-Ridden
stages.gives: Shift at will as a Free Action. In beast form: +3 Strength, +2 Toughness, DR 2, and natural weapons that ignore DR entirely.
stages.takes: The sight or smell of fresh blood triggers a shift with no check. −3 Serenity. Human form now feels like the costume.

stages.name: Turned
stages.gives: In beast form permanently: +4 Strength, +3 Toughness, DR 3, regeneration 2 per round, and immunity to non-silver Physical damage.
stages.takes: Loss of humanity. The character passes to GM control. What remains recognizes faces but not obligations. Retirement or a hunt.

afflictions.name: Vampirism
afflictions.contracted_by: Drained to Broken by a vampire, then given that vampire’s blood before the next sunrise.
afflictions.incubation: One full day, spent apparently dead. There is no resisting roll — the exchange was already consensual or already forced.
afflictions.cure: Consuming the blood of the sire’s own sire, or destruction of the sire before Stage 4. After Stage 4, only a Restoration performed on consecrated ground at dawn, and even then the character loses one Ability Score point permanently.

stages.name: Tainted
stages.gives: You no longer age. Ordinary disease cannot touch you.
stages.takes: Your reflection is slightly wrong in ways people notice without naming.

stages.name: Thirst
stages.gives: +1 Acuity. You see clearly in total darkness to Near range.
stages.takes: You must consume blood once per session or take −1 to all rolls until you do.

stages.name: Cold Flesh
stages.gives: DR 1 against all Physical damage. Immune to Poisoned and Bleeding.
stages.takes: Direct sunlight inflicts 1 Stamina box per round. −2 Morale in daylight regardless of cover.

stages.name: The Hunger
stages.gives: Feeding restores 3 boxes to any pool. +2 Strength. Charm as a Mind Effect at no Mana cost once per scene.
stages.takes: Cannot enter a private dwelling uninvited. Running water blocks your passage. Willpower check vs DC 14 to refuse an offered throat.

stages.name: Nocturnal
stages.gives: +3 Strength, Fast Movement, and the ability to assume mist or bat form once per scene.
stages.takes: Sunlight inflicts 3 Stamina boxes per round. You cast no reflection at all. Must rest in your grave-earth each day or gain a stage.

stages.name: Risen
stages.gives: Full undeath: no aging, no breath, no need for rest. +4 Strength, DR 3, regeneration 2 per round except from fire and holy sources.
stages.takes: Loss of humanity. The character passes to GM control. The hunger is now the whole personality. Sire or be hunted.

afflictions.name: Mummy Rot
afflictions.contracted_by: The touch of a bound or preserved undead, or the violation of a warded tomb.
afflictions.incubation: Immediate. A Toughness check vs DC 16 at the moment of contact prevents it.
afflictions.cure: Restoration performed by a Channeler with Belief 4+, on consecrated ground, removing one stage per attempt. Each attempt costs the Channeler 3 Resolve boxes that do not recover until a Full Rest.

stages.name: Touched
stages.gives: Pain registers dimly — ignore the first Condition applied to you each scene.
stages.takes: Skin greys at the point of contact. Cosmetic only.

stages.name: Drying
stages.gives: Immune to Bleeding. Wounds close without care.
stages.takes: −1 Toughness. Your Stamina pool maximum drops by 1.

stages.name: Withering
stages.gives: Mindless undead ignore you entirely unless you attack them first.
stages.takes: −2 Toughness. Stamina maximum drops by 2 total. Healing you receive is halved.

stages.name: Hollowing
stages.gives: You require no food or water. Exhaustion no longer accumulates.
stages.takes: −3 Toughness. Stamina maximum drops by 3 total. Any Full Rest restores only half the usual boxes.

stages.name: Desiccation
stages.gives: DR 2 against Physical damage — there is little left to damage.
stages.takes: −4 Toughness. Stamina maximum drops by 4 total. You cannot be healed above half your remaining maximum by any means.

stages.name: Preserved
stages.gives: You do not die. You cannot be destroyed by ordinary means, and you continue.
stages.takes: Loss of humanity. The character passes to GM control as a bound undead. Whatever animated the rot now animates you.

afflictions.name: Ghoul Fever
afflictions.contracted_by: A ghoul’s bite, or consuming meat that a ghoul had already claimed.
afflictions.incubation: One night. A Toughness check vs DC 14 on waking resists it.
afflictions.cure: A full month of clean food, isolation, and a Survive check vs DC 15 each week. Three consecutive successes remove one stage. Relapse resets the count.

stages.name: Feverish
stages.gives: Your night vision improves — see clearly in dim light to Far range.
stages.takes: Cooked food tastes like ash. No mechanical effect.

stages.name: Craving
stages.gives: Immune to ordinary disease and to Poisoned from natural sources.
stages.takes: You must eat raw meat once per session. Failing to costs −1 to all Body rolls.

stages.name: Sallow
stages.gives: +1 Agility. Your nails harden into usable natural weapons.
stages.takes: −1 Morale. Living creatures find your presence subtly wrong; −2 to first-impression social rolls.

stages.name: The Hunger
stages.gives: +2 Agility. Once per scene, a bite attack that ignores DR and applies Paralyzed on overage 3+.
stages.takes: Willpower check vs DC 13 when exposed to fresh corpses or you feed. Feeding on the dead grants Corruption +1.

stages.name: Carrion-Kin
stages.gives: Fast Movement, DR 1, and immunity to Frightened and Sickened.
stages.takes: You can no longer digest anything but corpse-flesh. Without it, 2 Stamina boxes per day. −3 Morale.

stages.name: Ghoul
stages.gives: Full transformation: +3 Agility, +2 Strength, paralytic bite, immunity to disease, poison, and Fear.
stages.takes: Loss of humanity. The character passes to GM control. Ghouls remember where they buried people they loved.

afflictions.name: Fae Bargain
afflictions.contracted_by: Accepting food, shelter, a gift, or a name from one of the Fair Folk — or striking any explicit deal with one.
afflictions.incubation: None. The bargain binds at the moment of acceptance.
afflictions.cure: Return the gift precisely as given, in the place it was given, at the same hour and season. Each returned gift removes one stage. Stage 5 cannot be returned — what was given at that point was not a gift.

stages.name: Noticed
stages.gives: Once per session, ask the GM one yes/no question about the immediate area. The answer is true but unhelpfully phrased.
stages.takes: The Fair Folk know your face. You cannot lie to one of them, though you may decline to speak.

stages.name: Indebted
stages.gives: +1 to any one Ability Score, chosen by the fae, not by you.
stages.takes: Once per session the GM names a small obligation. Refusing it costs 1 Resolve box and −1 Morale for the scene.

stages.name: Bound
stages.gives: Once per scene, reroll any one failed roll. The luck comes from somewhere.
stages.takes: Iron burns you — cold iron weapons deal +2 damage and iron restraints cannot be escaped by any means.

stages.name: Claimed
stages.gives: +2 to a second Ability Score, again chosen by the fae. You can see through glamour automatically.
stages.takes: You must accept any formal invitation from the Fair Folk. Willpower DC 15 to delay, never to refuse.

stages.name: Half-Kept
stages.gives: You no longer age. Glamour of your own: once per scene, appear as anyone you have seen.
stages.takes: Your true name is known and held. Anyone who learns it commands one action from you per scene.

stages.name: Taken
stages.gives: Immortality, beauty, and a place at a court that has stood for ten thousand years.
stages.takes: Loss of humanity. The character passes to GM control and joins the Fair Folk. Something that looks like them may come back. It will not be them.
